stops.title: Born in Bethlehem
stops.text: Jesus is born in David's town. Magi from the east come to honor him, and Herod feels threatened.

stops.title: Refuge in Egypt
stops.text: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes Mary and the child to Egypt until Herod dies.

stops.title: Growing up in Nazareth
stops.text: Back from Egypt, the family avoids Archelaus's Judea and settles in a small Galilean village.

stops.title: Baptized in the Jordan
stops.text: Jesus comes from Galilee to John at the Jordan to be baptized.

stops.title: Home base in Capernaum
stops.text: Jesus moves to a fishing town on the lake and calls his first disciples.

stops.title: Through Jericho
stops.text: On the way to Jerusalem, Jesus heals two blind men by the road.

stops.title: The last week in Jerusalem
stops.text: Jesus enters the city, teaches in the temple, is arrested, crucified, and raised.

stops.title: A mountain in Galilee
stops.text: The risen Jesus meets the eleven and sends them to make disciples of all nations.

stops.label: To Egypt

stops.label: Jordan River
